EN: Err... okay, okay, I said sorry. Take this, alright? Call it an apology.
ZH: 呃……好吧，好吧，我道歉了。拿着这个，行吧？就当是赔礼。

EN: Sure... let me think... They don't allow loud music after nine.
ZH: 行……让我想想……他们不允许九点后放吵闹的音乐。

EN: Is everyone this obnoxious here?
ZH: 这里人人都这么讨人厌吗？

EN: <Deep sigh>
ZH: <深深叹气>

EN: You want to make it right? Tell me something about the Institute I don't know.
ZH: 想将功补过吗？告诉我点关于学院我不知道的事。

EN: I am the ambassador of our group, ready to share knowledge and strategy.
ZH: 我是我们团体的代表，随时准备分享知识与战略。

EN: Please proceed to fol—fol—pwa ha ha, I can't keep it up...
ZH: 请跟我——跟我——噗哈哈，我装不下去了……

EN: Sorry, dude. I'm not the prez.
ZH: 抱歉，老兄。我不是这里的会长。

EN: Just messing with you. You're like the new pledge!
ZH: 逗你玩呢。你就像新入会的兄弟！

EN: What do we have here? Look at you. Not bad at all...
ZH: 我们这儿来的是什么？看看你。还真不赖……

EN: Nah, I'm joking. I'm too young to be a parent.
ZH: 别，我开玩笑的。我还太小，当不了爹妈。

EN: You don't know what you're missing, sweet pea.
ZH: 你可不知道自己错过了什么，小甜心。

EN: <Mockingly> “We're here to parley, not party.” So vanilla!
ZH: <嘲弄地>“我们是来和谈的，不是来派对的。”可真够索然无味的！

EN: Doesn't the Institute say our DNA's compromised?
ZH: 学院不是觉得我们DNA有问题吗？

EN: I have higher standards.
ZH: 我品味可高。

EN: This is official business. We're here to parley, not party.
ZH: 这是公务。我们是来和谈的，不是来派对的。

EN: Wanna take a break and do some biological hybridization?
ZH: 想歇会儿，搞点生物杂交吗？

EN: An unattended terminal. Let's see what it holds.
ZH: 一台没人照管的终端。看看里面有什么。

EN: It says they were experimenting with human bacterial biomes...
ZH: 上面说他们在拿人类的细菌微生物组做实验……

EN: And accidentally discovered a new yeast that makes highly addictive alcohol.
ZH: 还意外发现了一种酵母，能酿出极易上瘾的酒。

EN: Especially when mixed with chems... no wonder they got kicked out.
ZH: 尤其混着药物……难怪他们被赶出来了。

EN: And now they're drunk all the time. We won't get much intel here.
ZH: 现在他们整天醉醺醺的。在这儿我们拿不到什么情报了。

EN: It's the Vaulties! Our new buddies!
ZH: 是避难所的人！我们的新伙伴！

EN: Yeah, well, the bots have it now. But hey, take this instead.
ZH: 嗯，那好，现在那堆机器人可占着风头。不过，拿着这个吧。

EN: Whoa, dudes, don't say that. Like, take this, and maybe, you know, go smash them?
ZH: 哇，兄弟们，别那么说。拿上这个，然后，呃，去砸扁它们，怎么样？

EN: Wait! This wasn't worth our equipment. We want it back.
ZH: 等等！这可配不上我们的装备。我们要拿回去。

EN: I've half a mind to help the bots with their rampage.
ZH: 我有点想帮那些机器人大闹一场。

EN: Sorry about the mess... we like to party.
ZH: 抱歉弄乱了……我们喜欢开派对。

EN: And we got the chemistry gear shipment, thanks a lot.
ZH: 我们收到了化学设备，多谢了。

EN: So as promised, here's the scoop on the Institute: they hate your guts.
ZH: 所以按承诺，给你们学院的内幕：他们恨死你们了。

EN: Now if you'll excuse me, the party bots are going berserk next door...
ZH: 恕我失陪，隔壁的派对机器人正在发狂……

EN: Where there's bots, there's brew!
ZH: 有机器的地方，就有美酒！

EN: Well, if I ever needed a cautionary tale about drinking...
ZH: 好吧，要是我需要戒酒的警示故事，那就是这个……

EN: Get ready to go psycho and party like there's no tomorrow!
ZH: 准备好发狂，像没有明天一样狂欢吧！

EN: One last drink and all goes black!
ZH: 最后一杯，然后眼前一黑！

EN: The truce is about to expire. We must decide: lasting peace, or war with the Institute.
ZH: 停战即将到期。我们必须抉择：持久和平，还是与学院开战。

EN: For the Betterment of Mankind
ZH: 为人类的福祉

EN: Sign the treaty or deal with the envoys
ZH: 签署条约，或对付使者

EN: Look in the mirror after making your decision
ZH: 做出决定后照照镜子

EN: Time to choose between permanent peace or endless war with the Institute.
ZH: 是时候在与学院的永久和平与无休止的战争之间做出选择了。

EN: This is it. The moment that decides our vault's future.
ZH: 就是这一刻。决定我们避难所未来的时刻。

EN: Do we vow to erase a science-obsessed blight from the Commonwealth...
ZH: 我们是要发誓铲除联邦里那个痴迷科学的毒瘤……

EN: Or join forces with them and assert dominance over the Wasteland?
ZH: 还是与他们联手，主宰废土？

EN: Why do I feel so conflicted about either choices?
ZH: 为什么我对哪个选择都这么纠结？

EN: We meet again, delegate of the Overseer.
ZH: 我们又见面了，监督者的代表。

EN: So be it. Time to end this, once and for all.
ZH: 那就这样吧。是时候一劳永逸地结束这一切了。

EN: The generations to come will praise the choice we made today.
ZH: 子孙后代将赞颂我们今天的选择。

EN: You speak truly. Peaceful dissent drives progress, and it starts today.
ZH: 你说得对。和平的异议推动进步，就从今天开始。

EN: Heck no! Yippee ki-yay, motherkiller!
ZH: 才不要！哟呵，杀他妈个痛快！

EN: We sign this for our future. Together, for mankind.
ZH: 我们为我们的未来签下这份协议。同心协力，为了人类。

EN: We may never share the same vision, but we can still protect our children by standing together.
ZH: 我们也许永远无法共享愿景，但仍可并肩守护我们的孩子。

EN: From the cinders of our first contact grew a yearning for peace.
ZH: 在我们初次接触的余烬中，孕育出对和平的渴望。

EN: That yearning bore fruit in the shape of a truce both sides honored.
ZH: 那渴望结出了果实——一份双方都恪守的停战协定。

EN: Now that truce has ripened, ready to bud anew.
ZH: 如今那停战已然成熟，正要焕发新芽。

EN: So tell me this: will it bloom into an alliance?
ZH: 所以告诉我：它能否绽放为同盟？

EN: Well, there's no turning back now.
ZH: 唉，事到如今，没有回头路了。

EN: Have we sacrificed our children's future?
ZH: 我们是否牺牲了孩子的未来？

EN: Have we doomed the Commonwealth with a tyrannical choice?
ZH: 我们是否用一个专制的抉择给联邦带来了厄运？

EN: Doubt will always gnaw at me. I suppose that's the price of diplomacy.
ZH: 疑虑永远在啃噬我。我想这就是外交的代价。

EN: What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be done with the treaty and gone by now?
ZH: 你们在这儿做什么？你们不是该处理完条约，早就离开了吗？

EN: Why waste words, when weapons speak clearer.
ZH: 何必浪费口舌，武器的话说得更清楚。

EN: You assume it hasn't already happened and that we aren't just more copies. But if you insist.
ZH: 你以为这一切还没发生，以为我们并不只是又一批复制品。但如果你非要追问的话。

EN: We were made to understand you better. We are peaceful. Would we offer our weapons otherwise?
ZH: 制造我们的初衷是为了更好地理解你们。我们热爱和平。否则我们还会主动奉上武器吗？

EN: What is this? Explain yourself.
ZH: 这是怎么回事？解释清楚。

EN: Treachery! So, the Institute's true plan is to replace us one by one?
ZH: 背叛！所以，学院的真正计划是逐个替换我们？

EN: I'm uncomfortable the Institute making Synths in our image.
ZH: 学院制造我们的模样的合成人，让我很不舒服。

EN: Clearly, you seeing us wasn't part of the tour.
ZH: 显然，你们看到我们并不在参观行程之内。

EN: Armistice Artifice
ZH: 停战之伪

EN: Our salvage team took Bigsby to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned. Take this. You'll need it if you look for them.
ZH: 我们的救援队把比格斯比带到了原子玩具厂的仓库，但还没回来。拿上这个，找他们的时候会用到。

EN: Hi there! I'm Overseer Emma.
ZH: 喂，你好！我是监督者艾玛。

EN: You must be another of those poor souls that escaped from the Raiders.
ZH: 你一定是从掠夺者手中逃跑的那群可怜人中的一员。

EN: No, but I'm looking for a dog that was with them named Bigsby.
ZH: 我不是，但我在找一只和他们一起逃跑的狗，它叫比格斯比。

EN: Bigsby wasn't in Vault 199, but a member told me he may be in their sister Vault: 899. I should go check it out.
ZH: 比格斯比不在199号避难所，但一个成员告诉我它可能会在他们的姐妹避难所，899号。我应该去那儿看看。

EN: In Another Vault
ZH: 另一个避难所

EN: Find Bigsby.
ZH: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Look for Bigsby in Vault 899.
ZH: 在899号避难所寻找比格斯比。

EN: We took them to the Poseidon Energy offices. Too bad you won't live long enough to find them!
ZH: 我们把他们带去了海神能源办公室。真可惜你们不能活着见到他们了！

EN: Ha ha! Another idiot fell for our “helpful survivor” trap.
ZH: 哈哈！又有一个白痴上钩了，落入我们“提供帮助的幸存者”陷阱。

EN: Tell me where you've taken Bottle & Cappy, or else!
ZH: 最好告诉我瓶瓶和盖盖去了哪里，不然的话……

EN: A helpful survivor who escaped from the Raiders suggested I search Vault 177 for Bottle & Cappy. If I hurry, I might be able to catch up with them.
ZH: 一位幸存者刚从掠夺者手中逃出来，他建议我们去177号避难所寻找瓶瓶和盖盖。如果抓紧时间的话，说不定能追上他们。

EN: In Hot Pursuit
ZH: 火热追击

EN: Search Vault 177 for any sign of Bottle & Cappy.
ZH: 搜寻177号避难所关于瓶瓶和盖盖的消息。

EN: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
ZH: 追踪瓶瓶和盖盖的绑匪。

EN: You've done a remarkable job, soldier.
ZH: 战士，你们做得很好。

EN: I heard you're turning your Vault into a Brotherhood outpost.
ZH: 我听说你们要把避难所变成兄弟会的前哨。

EN: I'm pleased to say I can't think of a better place for it to be.
ZH: 我真的很高兴，因为我想不到它还可以成为什么更好的地方了。

EN: I'll see you there soon. Dismissed, soldier!
ZH: 我们应该会很快在那里见到的。战士们解散！

EN: We've almost proven the Vault's worthiness to the Brotherhood of Steel! Last task - a rescue mission at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 已经向钢铁兄弟会证明了我们避难所的价值！最后的任务——核子可乐工厂的救援行动。

EN: In Shining Armor
ZH: 闪耀的护甲

EN: Find the Brotherhood squad leader.
ZH: 找到兄弟会小队首领。

EN: Rescue the soldier from the Raiders at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 从核子可乐工厂里的掠夺者手中拯救那位战士。

EN: Thank you! You're a godsend!
ZH: 谢谢！你真是个小天使！

EN: Hello there, lonesome traveler, and welcome to my home!
ZH: 你好啊，孤单的旅行者，欢迎回家！

EN: I'm in a bit of a pickle, and would really appreciate a helping hand.
ZH: 我遇上了点麻烦，谁能帮帮我就好了。

EN: Seems I have a case of Radroach infestation... Could you take care of it for me?
ZH: 我好像遭了辐射蟑螂的虫害……你能帮我除掉它们吗？

EN: You're welcome to take anything you want from the basement as a reward!
ZH: 你可以从我这里带走任何一样你需要的东西作为奖励！

EN: No problem, ma'am, I'm on it.
ZH: 没问题，夫人，交给我吧。

EN: A woman living by herself in an abandoned cabin is being plagued by Radroaches. We should help her with that!
ZH: 一位独居女人住在一座废弃小屋里，房间遭了虫害。我们应该帮助她！

EN: Infested!
ZH: 虫害！

EN: Eradicate the Radroach infestation.
ZH: 除掉辐射蟑螂。

EN: Help a nice lady with her pest problem.
ZH: 帮助一位好心的女士解决害虫问题。

EN: Whoa, she wasn't kidding!
ZH: 哇哦，她真不是开玩笑！

EN: Go kill that Raider jerk, Frank the Tank. He's in that building down the road. This might help.
ZH: 去杀掉掠夺者“坦克弗兰克”，他是个混蛋。他在这条路上的那幢建筑里。希望这些信息能帮到你。

EN: Could you kill Frank the Tank? He raids us all the time. He's in that building down the road. This might help.
ZH: 你能杀掉“坦克弗兰克”吗？他总是将我们洗劫一空。他就在这条路上的那幢建筑里。希望这些消息能帮到你。

EN: Tell you what. You kill Frank the Tank. He's in that building down the road. Then we'll talk. This might help.
ZH: 我告诉你，你去杀了“坦克弗兰克”。他就在那幢建筑里。然后我们再谈谈。这个可能会有帮助。

EN: Whoa whoa whoa. Hold it right there. I'm Overseer Patel.
ZH: 诶……诶？等等。我是监督者帕特尔。

EN: You can't just walk around in here all willy nilly!
ZH: 你们可不能这么大摇大摆地在这里走来走去。

EN: We've had a lot of trouble with Raiders lately. Trust has to be earned!
ZH: 我们最近深受掠夺者的危害，你们必须要证明自己是可信的！

EN: Ugh. Fine. What do we need to do?
ZH: 呃，好的。我们应该怎么做？

EN: Gladly! What can we do to help?
ZH: 很高兴能帮助你们！我们能做些什么？

EN: Dang it, we've got questions! And you're going to answer them!
ZH: 别废话，当然是我们问问题，然后你们来回答！

EN: Paula Plumbkin escaped from the Feral Ghouls and headed to Vault 333. Hopefully we can catch up with her there.
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金从狂尸鬼的手里逃了出来，去向了333号避难所。希望我们能在那儿追上她。

EN: Into Vault 333!
ZH: 进入333号避难所！

EN: Explore Vault 333.
ZH: 探索333号避难所。

EN: Explore Vault 333 and find Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 探索333号避难所然后找到宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: What's this? A note on the ground?
ZH: 这是？地上写了什么？

EN: “So you're looking for Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, huh?
ZH: “所以你在找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫是吧？

EN: Well it's mine, and you'll never find it! - Coach”
ZH: 呃，它是我的，而你们永远不可能找到它！——教练”

EN: Maybe Rackie Jobinson's Jersey is in the Clear Morning Place Insane Asylum!
ZH: 也许罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫就在清晨之地精神病院里！

EN: Into the Infield
ZH: 进入到内场

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: A note on the ground!
ZH: 地上写了什么！

EN: “Okay, fine. You've proven I can't avoid you forever.
ZH: “好吧，你们已经证明了我不可能永远躲着你们。

EN: Let's end your crazy scavenger hunt once and for all.
ZH: 让我们一次性了结你们这个疯狂的寻宝游戏吧。

EN: Come to my hideout, the Dugout. - Coach”
ZH: 来我的据点，防空洞。——教练”

EN: Coach wasn't in the pet store, but there's a warehouse close by. He may have headed there...
ZH: 教练不在宠物商店里，但附近有个仓库，他可能去了那儿……

EN: Into the Outfield
ZH: 冲进外场

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: They're all below. Good luck!
ZH: 他们都在下面。祝你好运！

EN: Late in the evening on St. Patrick's Day. Think there's a link?
ZH: 在圣帕特里克节的傍晚。你们觉得有关联吗？

EN: Oh yeah, we dye them to celebrate St. Patrick's Day.
ZH: 哦，是的，我们给他们染色，庆祝圣帕特里克节。

EN: Help us, Dwellers. Our community is being Ghoulified!
ZH: 帮助我们，居民们。我们的社会正在尸鬼化！

EN: We set quarantine zones in the basement, but it keeps spreading.
ZH: 我们在地下室设置隔离区，但它仍在蔓延。

EN: We haven't heard from our leader in days...
ZH: 我们几天没有收到我们负责人的信了……

EN: Would you care for refreshments before you investigate?
ZH: 在我们调查前，要不要先喝点吃点？

EN: No thanks, we'd rather just see the afflicted.
ZH: 不，谢谢，我们宁愿看到受苦的人。

EN: When did this all start?
ZH: 这一切是什么时候开始的？

EN: These refreshments look very... green.
ZH: 这些点心看起来很……绿色。

EN: Beats me. Sure you don't want a pint of glowin' green?
ZH: 这可难倒我了。你们真不来一品脱泛着绿光的啤酒？

EN: You mean, apart from drinking green beer? Nope. Nothing at all.
ZH: 你的意思是，除了喝绿色啤酒？不。没影儿的事。

EN: It's so refreshing it tickles your throat as it goes down...
ZH: 它清爽得让喉咙阵阵发痒，顺着嗓子一路下去……

EN: Hey there, have you come to rescue us?
ZH: 嘿，你是来救我们的吗？

EN: Some here have already started to turn into Ghouls.
ZH: 这里的一些人已经开始变成尸鬼。

EN: I think I'll drown my sorrows in a pint of green beer...
ZH: 我想我会用一品脱绿啤酒来淹没我的悲伤……

EN: First, we need to figure out what's causing all this.
ZH: 首先，我们需要弄清楚是什么导致了这一切。

EN: Did you do anything out of the ordinary these past few days?
ZH: 这几天你做了什么不寻常的事吗？

EN: Is green beer really that good?
ZH: 绿啤酒真的那么好吗？

EN: Impossible! We brew it ourselves, add some Biohazard brand dye, and...oooh.
ZH: 不可能！我们自己酿的，就是加了些“生物危害”牌的染料，然后……哦。

EN: Just some Biohazard brand dye we found in old drums... oooh.
ZH: 只是一些我们从旧鼓桶里找到的“生物危害”牌染料……哦。

EN: Are you saying that “Biohazard” *isn't* a brand of food coloring?
ZH: 你是说“生物危害”不是一个食品着色剂的品牌？

EN: This is just terrible!
ZH: 这太可怕了！

EN: All we wanted was to celebrate St. Patrick's Day...
ZH: 我们只是想庆祝圣帕特里克节……

EN: ...and drink lots of green beer.
ZH: 喝很多绿色啤酒。

EN: Now look at us!
ZH: 现在看看我们！

EN: I'm starting to think the beer may have something to do with it.
ZH: 我开始认为啤酒可能与它有关。

EN: What do you guys put in the beer to make it green?
ZH: 你们往啤酒里放了什么东西让它变绿了？

EN: The green beer is making you sick.
ZH: 绿啤酒会让你们生病。

EN: Nearby Settlers have become very sick following the annual St. Patrick's Day festivities, with some reported cases of Ghoulification! This might just be, um, “food” poisoning, but we should investigate in case it's an actual epidemic...
ZH: 随着一年一度圣帕特里克节庆祝活动的到来，附近的一些定居者病得很厉害。一些病例报告显示他们正在逐渐变成尸鬼。这可能只是，呃，“食物”中毒，但我们应该调查此事，以防它是一个真正的流行病……

EN: It's not Easy Being Green
ZH: 变绿不容易

EN: Meet with the settlement leader.
ZH: 会见居民负责人。

EN: Visit Yellow quarantine zone.
ZH: 访问黄色检疫区。

EN: Visit Red quarantine zone.
ZH: 访问红色检疫区。

EN: Help nearby Settlers deal with a strange epidemic.
ZH: 帮助附近的定居者解决一个奇怪的流行病。

EN: That's the leader? I don't think we'll get much from him...
ZH: 那就是负责人？我不认为我们会从他那里得到很多信息……

EN: You know, perhaps these might explain the epidemic.
ZH: 你知道，也许这些解释了流行病。

EN: Adding anything to a pint o' Gat is a *crime*...
ZH: 加入任何一点那个东西都是罪过……

EN: We sold him to a cannery that's been producing Potted Meat. But you? You, we're just gonna kill!
ZH: 我们把他卖给了肉酱罐头厂。但你们？我们会直接杀了你们！

EN: You here for the sale?
ZH: 你们是来做生意的吗？

EN: Maybe you heard about Jack? He woulda fetched us a fine price!
ZH: 你听说过杰克吗？如果你们有他的话，我们的出价可不会低！

EN: He was a wild one! Most Dwellers can't win a Mexican knife fight!
ZH: 他可是个厉害角色！大部分居民是不可能在墨西哥刀战上胜出的！

EN: Not a great idea to combine Absinthe and Ultrajet. We had to get rid of him - he was out of control!
ZH: 把苦艾酒和超强捷特混在一起可不是好主意。我们只好把他处理掉——他已经完全失控了！

EN: What'd you do with him? Is he alive?
ZH: 你们把他怎么了？他还活着吗？

EN: The Overseer's son got married to a Raider, but she sold him to Slavers! We have to catch them before they disappear west!
ZH: 监督者的儿子和一个掠夺者结婚了，但她把他卖给了奴隶贩子！我们必须赶紧抓住他们！

EN: Jack Ain't Back
ZH: 杰克没有回来

EN: Find Jack!
ZH: 找到杰克！

EN: First married, then sold to Slavers... Can we get to Jack in time?
ZH: 先结了婚，然后被卖给了奴隶贩子……我们能够及时找回杰克吗？

EN: Journey to the Center of Vaultopolis
ZH: 避难所大都会中心之旅

EN: The Wasteland is full of junk, but sometimes that's just what you need...
ZH: 废土上充满了杂物，但有的时候你需要找到你所需要的那种……
